summary: Game crashes when dispensing a shulker box from a dispenser - "java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking"
description: (1.16 Pre-Release 3) [^crash-2020-06-10_18.21.22-server.txt] Description: Exception while ticking java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking at bil.a(SourceFile:88) at gy.a(SourceFile:23) at gu.dispense(SourceFile:15) at bxc.a(SourceFile:89) at bxc.a(SourceFile:112) at cfi$a.a(SourceFile:865) at zd.b(SourceFile:596) at zd$$Lambda$3895/290764432.accept(Unknown Source) at bqn.b(SourceFile:84) at zd.a(SourceFile:351) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:873) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:813) at eox.a(SourceFile:93) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.v(SourceFile:672) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:256) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer$$Lambda$3883/2115162896.run(Unknown Source) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.16 Pre-Release 3.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Place a dispenser on the ground.
4. Insert a shulker box into the dispenser.
5. Right-click the dispenser to activate it.
6. Observe that the game crashes with "java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking".
7. Take a screenshot of the crash screen or gather the corresponding `crash-reports/*.txt` file from the `.minecraft/debug` folder.
8. Note the exact steps and conditions under which the crash occurs for documentation purposes.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when a shulker box is dispensed from a dispenser, triggering the error "java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking" in Minecraft version 1.16 Pre-Release 3. The stack trace indicates that the exception originates at `bil.a(SourceFile:88)` and propagates through various classes such as `gy`, `gu`, `bxc`, and others, ultimately leading to the crash. This issue occurs specifically when a shulker box is being dispensed from a dispenser, causing the server to halt with the aforementioned exception. The exact sequence of events involves the game attempting to process the dispensing action but encountering a null value that it cannot handle, resulting in the NullPointerException and subsequent crash. To reproduce this bug, place a shulker box inside a dispenser and activate it; the game will then crash with the specified error message.
Expected Behavior: When a shulker box is dispensed from a dispenser, the game should not crash. Instead, the shulker box should be successfully ejected from the dispenser and land in the world without any exceptions or errors occurring. The server should remain stable and continue to function normally after the dispensing action.
